task.question: In which city will the 2026 UEFA Conference League final take place?
task.evidence: 27 May: 2026 UEFA Conference League final in Leipzig, Germany

answer:
The 2026 UEFA Conference League final will take place in Wrocław, Poland.

FINAL: Wrocław
